AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.subtitle: My journey, skills, and experience.
AboutPage.cover_letter_placeholder:
I am a builder at heart. With a B.Sc. in Space Engineering and over a decade of experience in technical project management—ranging from seismic operations at sea to coordinating EU space funding at Vinnova—I have always been fascinated by complex systems.

In 2023, I pivoted fully to Software Development. I don't just write code; I apply an engineering mindset to modern web development. I am an 'AI-First' developer, utilizing LLMs and tools like Cursor daily to accelerate workflows, generate robust testing suites, and architect scalable solutions faster than traditional methods allow.

Beyond the screen, I am driven by curiosity and discipline. I apply the same optimization mindset to my health and training as I do to my code. I am a history buff, an avid gamer, and an outdoorsman who finds clarity in nature—whether camping or hunting. In both work and life, I value authenticity and deep connections over transactional interactions.
AboutPage.intro: I am a passionate Fullstack & Blockchain Engineer dedicated to building scalable, user-centric applications. With a strong foundation in modern web technologies and decentralized systems, I strive to create digital experiences that make a difference.
